svg.title: Server 1.31.0's latency buckets: 19 edges, and 12 pilot windows against them
svg.desc: Top: the 19 edges of server 1.31.0's latency histograms in seconds, as the lab host's Prometheus listed them for the five the gate reads, on a log scale, then +Inf. Middle: the pilot's five p-readings, a row each, a dot a load window, across in ms with the edges from 5 to 50 ms drawn through them. Bottom: activity schedule-to-start p99 against its share past 10 ms, a dot a window: at or under a 1% share the p99 reads at the 10 ms edge, past it the p99 is placed inside the 10 to 20 ms bucket. Sources: docs/tables/fig-bucket-edges.jsonl, docs/tables/gate-readings-2.jsonl, docs/tables/gate-readings.jsonl, docs/tables/gates.jsonl.
